pricing.question: Is there a usage fee?
pricing.answer: Currently, all basic features are available for free. This includes Google Calendar integration and all scheduling features.

calendar.question: Do I need to set up Google Calendar integration?
calendar.answer: Google account authentication is required on first use. After authentication, calendar events are automatically created with your configured notifications.

features.question: Can I request new features?
features.answer: Yes! Feel free to suggest features via Twitter, Reddit, or GitHub above. We value feedback from our users.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Schedule information is securely stored in your browser (localStorage). No data is sent to external servers, protecting your privacy.

platforms.question: Which social media platforms are supported?
platforms.answer: Currently supports Twitter(X), Reddit, and Threads. We plan to add more platforms in the future.

disclaimer.title: Terms of Use
disclaimer.content: Please use scheduled content in accordance with each platform's terms of service. This service only provides schedule management - actual posting is done by users themselves. We are not responsible for posted content.
